text: A D.C. Circuit panel upheld the Pentagon's designation of Anthropic as a supply-chain risk, preserving restrictions on military use of Claude. A separate federal court previously invalidated a parallel designation under different law.

meta.note: The panel delayed effect of its ruling while Anthropic may seek further review.

text: Coca-Cola named Monster Energy Americas head Rob Gehring to lead its North America unit effective Dec. 1. Gehring previously led growth functions at Monster and served as CEO of Swire Coca-Cola USA.

meta.note: The appointment is announced; the leadership transfer becomes effective Dec. 1.
